title: Primary triads: I, IV and V
description: Basic major-key harmony centered on I, IV and V.

title: Triads with vi
description: Adds vi, the relative-minor triad, to the primary chords.

title: Triads with ii
description: Includes ii, the minor supertonic triad.

title: Triads with iii or vii diminished
description: Includes iii, the minor mediant, or the leading-tone diminished triad.

title: Seventh chords and extensions
description: Includes dominant and other seventh chords, plus richer chord extensions.
